The '''headquarters''' of [[Onadax Droid Technologies]] were a compound on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onadax]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] [[Mission to Onadax|infiltrated]] them in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]] to confront [[Stanton Rendar (droid)|Stanton Rendar]]. She used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to sneak past several [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] security guards.
